title: Geometry Basics
description: Basic geometry covering shapes, angles, area, perimeter, and volume

questions.question: What do the three interior angles of any triangle add up to?
questions.explanation: In Euclidean geometry the interior angles of a triangle always sum to 180 degrees, no matter the triangle's shape or size.

questions.question: How many sides does a hexagon have?
questions.explanation: A hexagon has 6 sides. A 5-sided figure is a pentagon and an 8-sided one is an octagon.

questions.question: What is the area of a rectangle that is 8 cm long and 3 cm wide?
questions.explanation: Area of a rectangle is length × width, so 8 cm × 3 cm = 24 cm². The value 22 is the perimeter in cm, not the area.

questions.question: What is the perimeter of a square with sides of 5 m?
questions.explanation: A square has four equal sides, so the perimeter is 4 × 5 m = 20 m. The value 25 m² would be its area.

questions.question: What is a triangle with all three sides of equal length called?
questions.explanation: An equilateral triangle has three equal sides and three 60-degree angles. An isosceles triangle has exactly two equal sides and a scalene triangle has none.

questions.question: What is the area of a triangle with a base of 10 cm and a height of 6 cm?
questions.explanation: Area of a triangle is ½ × base × height, so ½ × 10 cm × 6 cm = 30 cm².

questions.question: Which formula gives the circumference of a circle with radius r?
questions.explanation: Circumference is 2πr, the distance around the circle. The expression πr² is the circle's area instead.

questions.question: What do the interior angles of a quadrilateral add up to?
questions.explanation: A quadrilateral can be split into two triangles, so its interior angles total 2 × 180 = 360 degrees.

questions.question: What is the volume of a cube with edges of 3 cm?
questions.explanation: Volume of a cube is edge³, so 3 cm × 3 cm × 3 cm = 27 cm³. The value 54 cm² is its total surface area.

questions.question: A right triangle has legs of 3 cm and 4 cm. How long is its hypotenuse?
questions.explanation: By the Pythagorean theorem, a² + b² = c², so 3² + 4² = 9 + 16 = 25 and c = 5 cm.
